> Teaching story. Living project architecture for humans and review grounding. Not Typology seed evidence (see `evidence/typology/architecture_brief.md`).
`gitboard` functions as a local interface for observing code changes across remote git providers. The system is organized into functional slices that separate the entrypoint, the serving layer, and the specialized logic for git interaction and process execution.
### Entrypoint and Serving
The application starts via the `gitboard` command (`cmd/gitboard`), which acts as the primary entrypoint. It initializes the `server` slice (`internal/server`), which provides the HTTP capabilities required to host the local web interface. This server wires request handlers to the various functional components of the system.
### Git and Dashboard Slices
The system interacts with remote repositories through the `remotegit` slice (`internal/remotegit`), which provides standardized adapters for services like GitHub and GitLab. Data surfaced by these adapters is processed by the `dashboard` slice (`internal/dashboard`), which aggregates views to present a unified local board of changes.
### Execution and Automation
For tasks requiring local system interaction, such as running external tools or managing branches, the system utilizes the `cliexec` slice (`internal/cliexec`) to execute processes via the operating system. Specialized logic, such as branch investigation, is handled by the `pruneagent` slice (`internal/pruneagent`).
